unlisted_practices: Embedding odds-ratio-derived statistical reasoning into LLM fine-tuning prompts to improve accuracy and traceability
Adding wearable-derived behavioral features to clinical variables for depressive symptom screening

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a hybrid statistical reasoning-augmented LLM framework on retrospective wearable and clinical data to screen for depressive symptoms. While a chatbot interface was built, the evaluation is an offline diagnostic benchmark without testing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
